The Accountant II is responsible for overseeing and developing the Accounting and Finance function for our new US factory located in the state of Indiana. Primary Responsibilities:

Position Title:    Supervisor, Sourcing

Department:   Supply Chain

Entity:              PVJC

Reports To:         Sourcing Manager, Supply Chain

Location:         Jeffersonville, IN

Position Summary:

We are seeking a Supervisor, Sourcing with a strong background in managing raw materials procurement. This role will be crucial in ensuring efficient and cost-effective supply chain operations, from the initial program kickoff through to product launch. The Supervisor, Sourcing, will be responsible for sourcing and managing relationships with suppliers of raw materials and equipment, ensuring that our operations are profitable and aligned with our industry standards.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Work closely with engineering, production, and quality assurance teams to understand material requirements and ensure that procurement strategies support production needs and product quality.

• Manage/source the new supplier development program and maintain current supplier commercial communication to assure the production needs and requirement.

• Utilize negotiation and accountability skills to build effective vendor relationships

• Manage tracking for the new supplier program cost and timing, organize regular management reviews to ensure the program within budget and launching on time.

• Provide support to the Inside Sales department to follow up on deliveries; Provide tracking numbers and ETAs to ensure freight arrive on time to the correct location

• Support cost reduction and other business improvement initiatives

• Adhere to efficiency processes (i.e. JIT) to ensure compliance

• Work to maintain and balance our Logistics transparency internally and externally

• Create request for quotation (RFQ); Meet with vendors and select vendors based on price, service and ability to meet production needs

• Process purchase requisitions from internal departments and ensure proper approvals have been given prior to placing items on order

• Liaise with freight forwarder, domestic and international suppliers regularly to monitor the status of shipment and ensure materials arrive on time

• Identify and communicate issues arising from the supply of materials and services with both the vendor and internal material team

• Monitor, evaluate, and analyze vendor and supplier performance to ensure quality and delivery requirements are met

• Manage supplier relationships and update management on any issues with vendors

• Manage, maintain and update Material Requirement Planning (MRP) data and investigate abnormal material usage

• Monitor production schedules to assess future production needs; Balance available materials on order with ongoing production requirements

• Participate in weekly planning and purchasing conference calls

• Perform new material cost evaluation for management review

• Take on additional tasks when other departmental staff are absent

• Support ISO 9001 activities

• Identify potential risks in the supply chain and develop contingency plans to mitigate disruptions. Stay informed about market changes and supply chain dynamics that may impact procurement activities.

• Maintain awareness of use of SAP (ERP system)

Qualifications and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management or an acceptable combination of education and progressively responsible experience

• 2-5 years work experience in a supervisory capacity of purchasing, logistics and SQEs.

• Strong knowledge of general office procedures involving procurement, travel arrangements, budget management, and reports

• Ability to write and format moderately complex correspondence, including memos and letters

• Accuracy and attention to detail required

• Excellent writing skills; Proper spelling, grammar, and punctuation is required

• Superior time management and multitasking skills required

• Ability to prioritize tasks with minimal supervision

• Strong resourcefulness and flexibility

• Strong communication skills with all levels of the organization

• Strong customer service orientation, interpersonal skills, and telephone manners

• Able to deal with people sensitively, tactfully, confidentially, diplomatically, and professionally at all times

• Able to work efficiently as a part of a team as well as independently

• Computer literacy, including effective working skills with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), CNM, and e-mail required

Compensation and Benefits:

CS Powertech offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a 401(k) Retirement Plan, medical/dental/life/disability program, PTO and sick days. This is a full-time position.

Note: The company reserves the right to change the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time as its own discretion.

CS Powertech is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Position Title: Quality System Supervisor

Department: Quality

Reports To: Quality Manager

Description:

The Quality System Manager is responsible for operating the ISO9001 Quality Management System (QMS), writing procedures and processes to support the QMS development. Lead and undertake audits across all areas of the business. He/she will drive quality system performance review, provide training and champion the Quality Management System.

Responsibilities:

· Oversee effective implementation of the Quality Management System throughout the company.

· Maintain the Quality Manuals and Standard Operation Procedures and ensure contents are appropriate for business, analyze current and future procedural needs of the business.

· Organize and manage the plant internal audit system and the corrective action reporting system.

· Lead Document Control process and quality data analysis

· Conduct Quality Systems audits and assist in training/guidance to other auditors.

· Host external Quality System audits and customer audits

· Coordinate the review of Quality procedures associated with plant continuous improvement initiatives, host risk management.

· Investigate quality case to make improvements to achieve better customer satisfaction

· Collate quality data for monitoring targets, report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to adhere to process and prevent occurrence of any non-conformity relating to product, process, or system.

· Prepare and present reports and metrics to the accountable manager and senior management on the performance of the quality systems, assistance Management Review process.

· Ensure that all business activities are performed with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with the Canadian Solar Solution Code of Business Conduct

· Adhere to all environmental, health and safety rules and policies.

· Conduct other duties as required.

Qualifications and Experience:

· Business/commercial or manufacturing/engineering degree preferred.

· Special consideration given to ISO9001 QMS courses completed with QMS Lead Auditor certification.

· Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain ISO9001 QMS system.

· Previous experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment

· Experience of working in Quality Assurance

· Six Sigma/Lean Manufacturing skills

· Strong leadership abilities and confident, consistent, decisive personality

· Must be able to work with little supervision, must be self-directed.

· Desire for innovative thinking and continual learning

· Excellent coaching, mentoring, mediating, and negotiating skills.

· Computer literacy, including effective working skills with MS Office and e-mail required.

Position Title: Supplier Quality Supervisor

Department: Quality

Reports To: Quality Manager

Description:

The Supplier Quality Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the supplier quality managing to ensure that products and components sourced from suppliers meet the company's quality standards and specifications. The supervisor will lead a team and collaborate closely with other departments and suppliers to develop and maintain robust quality systems, resolve quality issues, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external suppliers.

Responsibilities:

· Develop and implement supplier quality management system.

· Supervises and provide guidance to the supplier quality engineers, including assigning work, monitoring performance, and conducting regular performance evaluations.

· Investigate and resolve supplier-related quality issues, including non-conformances, defects, claim, and customer complaints.

· Evaluate supplier performance, introduce new supplier/material, review and approve supplier engineering change, do first article inspection.

· Lead cross-functional teams to investigate material related quality issues and drive solutions.

· Collaborate with suppliers to ensure timely resolution of quality issues and prevent recurrence.

· Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers to foster continuous improvement.

· Assume responsibility for technical responses to suppliers on quality issues; lead investigations and drive corrective actions.

· Liaise with Suppliers during visits, conduct process/system audits.

· Track and resolve open issues pertaining to new product launches, develop control documents and other Customer/Supplier required quality documentation.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives with suppliers to enhance product quality and reliability

· Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost reductions related to supplier quality.

· Support IQC inspection training, test equipment set up, Control plan and SIP updates

· Ensure that all business activities are performed with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with the Canadian Solar Solution Code of Business Conduct

· Support ISO 9001 activities

· Adhere to all environmental, health and safety rules and policies.

· Conduct other duties as required.

Qualifications and Experience:

· Bachelor’s Degree (minimum of 4 years) or equivalent years of education; Special consideration given to Quality Accreditation’s (AQC/AIAG) and technical courses completed (Auditor, etc.)

· Proven experience in quality control or quality assurance within a manufacturing environment, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role.

· Demonstrated ability to drive process/product quality control, lean manufacturing.

· Good current working knowledge of AIAG standards (PQP, PPAP & PFMEA, Cpk, SPC, 8D )

· Strong Knowledge in SAP system or other related software applications

· Six sigma an asset

· Quality Control background, including problem solving and root cause analysis.

· Professional demeanour at all times

· Strong leadership abilities and confident, consistent, decisive personality

· Must be able to work with little supervision, must be self-directed.

· Attention to detail in all area of work

· Desire for innovative thinking and continual learning

· Excellent coaching, mentoring, mediating and negotiating skills.

· Computer literacy, including effective working skills with MS Office and e-mail required.

· Good written and verbal communication skills in English

Working Environment

This position operates in a manufacturing facility and office environment and may require interaction with employees, contractors, visitors, and leadership teams across multiple functions.

Compensation and Benefits:

CS Powertech offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a 401(k) Retirement Plan, medical/dental/life/disability program, PTO and sick days. This is a full-time position.

Position Title:   Facility Supervisor II

Department: Facility

Reports To: Facility Manager

Location: Jeffersonville, Indiana

The Facility Supervisor II will report to the Facility Manager. Will assist in overseeing and maintaining the establishment and ongoing operations of the company’s grounds, buildings and equipment to ensure that the workspace is safe and functional. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in facility management, HVAC, scrubbers, water treatment systems, electrical systems, factory layout, and a thorough understanding of local laws and regulations.

Primary Responsibilities:

Facility Management:

• Oversee the operation and maintenance of building systems, including HVAC systems, MAU, RAU, Scrubbers, Chillers, Boilers, Chemical and Waste Management, electrical systems, cleanroom environment (Temperature & Humidity Control and Pressure Control), UPW, PCW, Vacuum & CDA system and specialty gases and chemicals.

• Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures for all facility systems.

• Ensure the facility system is consistent operating at optimum level.

Project Management:

• Plan, coordinate, and manage facility improvement projects, including renovations, upgrades, and repairs.

• Collaborate with contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.

• Prepare project plans, budgets, and timelines, and report on project progress.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to building systems and equipment.

• Conduct regular inspections and audits to identify maintenance needs and potential improvements.

Safety and Compliance:

• Ensure that all facility operations comply with local, state, and federal safety regulations and standards.

• Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.

• Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.

• Monitor and manage energy consumption to promote sustainability and reduce costs.

• Identify and implement energy-saving initiatives and best practices.

• Track and analyze utility usage and costs, and report on energy efficiency.

• Monitor and manage waste generated to ensure compliance to EPA requirements

Documentation and Reporting:

• Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, facility inspections, and equipment performance.

• Prepare and present reports on facility operations, maintenance, and project status.

• Ensure documentation is up-to-date and compliant with regulatory requirements.

• Vendor and Contractor Management:

• Coordinate and oversee the work of external vendors and contractors.

• Review and approve service contracts, purchase orders, and invoices.

• Evaluate vendor performance and ensure service quality meets facility standards.

Team Collaboration:

• Work closely with facility staff, management, and other departments to address facility needs and support operational goals.

• Provide training and support to staff on facility-related procedures and safety practices.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in facility management, building systems maintenance, or a similar role.

• Ability to lead a team in a fast-paced high-tech manufacturing environment

• Strong knowledge of building systems, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems.

• Familiarity with safety regulations and industry standards.

• Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.

• Proficiency in facility management software and tools.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Skills:

• Certification in facility management (e.g., Certified Facility Manager (CFM), Facility Management Professional (FMP)).

• Experience with energy management and sustainability practices.

• Knowledge of regulatory requirements specific to the industry or facility type.

• Proficiency in both English and Mandarin is a plus.

• Ability to adapt to changing technologies and industry trends.

• Willingness to continuously learn and update skills.

Standard office environment with frequent visits to facility areas and production environments.

May require occasional travel to other facilities or vendor locations.

May involve working outside of regular hours to address facility issues or oversee projects.

Position Title:    Raw Material Laboratory Engineer

Department:   Quality Technical / Reliability Laboratory

Reports To:         Quality Technical Manager

Description:

The Raw Material Laboratory Engineer supports advanced material research, testing, and characterization activities focused on understanding raw material performance, degradation mechanisms, process sensitivity, and product reliability. This position applies engineering principles, Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, and laboratory testing to evaluate materials and provide data-driven technical recommendations.

The Engineer works closely with Engineering, Quality, Process, Reliability, and Supplier Quality teams to support material selection, supplier qualification, product development, root-cause investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

Research & Experimental Design

• Design and execute Design of Experiments (DOE) to evaluate raw material performance, variability, aging behavior, and process sensitivity

• Define experimental factors, responses, controls, and acceptance criteria based on engineering objectives and material science principles

• Plan and execute structured laboratory studies to evaluate material performance and reliability

• Conduct root-cause investigations related to material performance deviations, defects, or failures

• Develop technical conclusions and recommendations based on experimental findings

Material Testing & Characterization

• Perform laboratory testing and characterization of raw materials, including polymers, sealants, metals, glass, coatings, and other manufacturing materials

• Evaluate material properties such as curing behavior, mechanical performance, thermal aging, durability, and environmental exposure effects

• Operate laboratory equipment and testing instrumentation in accordance with established procedures and safety requirements

• Develop and optimize testing approaches to improve accuracy, repeatability, and efficiency

• Evaluate material performance against applicable specifications, standards, and engineering requirements

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze experimental and laboratory data using statistical methods, DOE tools, and engineering principles

• Identify trends, correlations, variations, and potential failure mechanisms within material performance data

• Interpret results and translate findings into clear technical conclusions and actionable recommendations

• Prepare technical reports, data summaries, charts, and presentations for Engineering, Quality, and management reviews

• Maintain accurate and traceable records of laboratory testing, analysis, and technical findings

Method Development & Improvement

• Develop, validate, refine, and standardize laboratory test methods and experimental protocols

• Conduct correlation studies between laboratory results, production performance, and field data

• Identify opportunities to improve testing methodologies, laboratory processes, and material evaluation criteria

• Support standardization of testing and experimental approaches across materials, products, and suppliers

• Implement improvements that enhance laboratory capability, testing reliability, and data quality

Quality Systems & Documentation

• Conduct laboratory activities in accordance with applicable quality systems and standards, including ISO/IEC 17025 and ISO 9001 principles

• Ensure proper documentation, sample traceability, test record accuracy, and data integrity

• Maintain compliance with established laboratory procedures, specifications, and testing requirements

• Support laboratory audits, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities as required

• Follow all laboratory safety, risk assessment, PPE, and equipment usage requirements

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Raw Material Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Quality, Process Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supplier Quality teams

• Provide technical support for material-related investigations and manufacturing concerns

• Participate in technical discussions with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and other external partners as needed

• Support supplier qualification and material change evaluations through laboratory testing and technical analysis

• Communicate laboratory findings and engineering recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer Science, or a related engineering or technical field

• Knowledge of material characterization, experimental methods, laboratory testing, or material performance evaluation

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical data analysis concepts

• Ability to analyze technical data, identify trends, and develop engineering conclusions and recommendations

• Ability to independently manage laboratory testing and engineering assignments while collaborating with cross-functional teams

Preferred

• Master’s or PhD in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer Science, or a related field

• Hands-on laboratory or industrial material testing experience

• Experience with statistical or DOE software such as Minitab, JMP, Python, or MATLAB

• Familiarity with material testing standards, including ASTM, ISO, and IEC

• Experience with polymers, sealants, coatings, glass, metals, or other raw materials used in manufacturing

• Experience supporting material qualification, supplier evaluation, reliability testing, or root-cause investigations

• Experience working within an ISO-controlled laboratory or manufacturing environment

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Strong understanding of experimental design, data integrity, and technical analysis

• Ability to independently organize and execute laboratory testing activities

• Strong technical writing, documentation, and presentation skills

• Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, repeatable testing

• Ability to translate laboratory findings into practical engineering recommendations

Work Environment

• Laboratory and manufacturing environment with controlled testing conditions

• Requires handling of material samples, laboratory equipment, and testing instrumentation

• Requires compliance with established laboratory safety, quality, and PPE requirements

• Works closely with Engineering, Quality, Process, Manufacturing, Reliability, and other cross-functional teams

• May require periodic interaction with production areas, suppliers, or other technical teams

Engineering Responsibilities & Impact

• Apply Design of Experiments (DOE) and engineering methodologies to real-world material engineering challenges

• Perform material characterization, testing, statistical analysis, and technical interpretation

• Apply engineering findings to support material selection, supplier qualification, manufacturing performance, and product reliability

• Develop and implement test methods to evaluate material performance, durability, and reliability

• Provide technical recommendations based on laboratory data and engineering analysis

• Support root-cause investigations and corrective actions related to raw material performance

• Contribute to laboratory quality systems, testing procedures, engineering standards, and continuous improvement initiatives

Prior experience in the renewable energy industry; BESS is an asset

Senior Performance Controls Engineer - North America

Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Role Overview for Senior Performance Engineer

In this role, you’ll bring together the sharp analytical mindset of a controls engineer and the hands‑on problem‑solving instincts of a commissioning engineer to efficiently troubleshoot complex issues and pinpoint root causes on operating systems.

You’ll take ownership of diagnosing performance challenges and work closely with internal teams and external vendors to drive solutions, validating and evaluating firmware and software updates to ensure system security and reliability, minimizing downtime. Your insights will feed back to internal teams and product improvements to drive a cycle of continuous improvement.

If you thrive on tackling new challenges, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and love the satisfaction of solving problems that matter, this role keeps you continuously engaged and at the center of meaningful, hands‑on innovation.

What You’ll Be Doing as a Senior Performance Controls Engineer

• Prioritize, investigate, and drive the corrective action for performance issues identified during facility operation.

• Troubleshooting and root cause analysis using data analysis, first principles, on site investigation, or other means as needed.

• Validate software/firmware updates in coordination with vendors, the site service team, and relevant stakeholders to confirm documented changes and no unintended consequences are introduced. Coordinate subsequent rollouts with the appropriate site service teams.

• Effectively communicate issues to the appropriate vendor and stakeholders to ensure resolutions are identified and implemented.

• Support performance testing as required under individual contracts for each facility.

• Contribute to fleet wide efforts for improving the efficacy of monitoring and analysis processes and tools.

• Collaborate with internal teams to provide input to improve performance across the business from applications and design to project execution and commissioning to service.

• Provide documentation of issues and resolutions for tracking, knowledge sharing, and internal and external communications.

• Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with safety protocols, engineering standards, and company policies.

What You’ll Bring to the Position

• Demonstrated experience in customer-focused problem solving

• Ability to execute projects and tasks in parallel, self-directed, highly detail-oriented, organized and flexible

• Experience troubleshooting using data analytics

• Experience in commissioning, performance testing, maintenance, and/or design of BESS or other power generating facilities

• Knowledge and experience with SCADA protocols (i.e. DNP3 and Modbus)

• Familiarity with industrial communication networks (fiber optics, network switches, TCP/IP, etc.)

• Excellent communication skills

• Ability to travel up to 20% of time. Travel may be on short notice

• Demonstrated experience in problem solving

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

• Integrity: We do what’s right, always.

• Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.

• Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.

• Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.

• Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

• Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.

• Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.

• Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.

• Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

• The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.

• Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

• A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

Our Commitment to Equality & Diversity

“At e-STORAGE, we know that diverse teams drive innovation and better results. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered—regardless of age, race, gender, ability, or background. When you join us, you’re joining a community that celebrates your uniqueness and supports your success.”

— Libby, Sr. Global HR Manager

Position Title:  LTSA Service Manager

Department:   Project Implementation & Long-Term Service

Entity:                CS e-STORAGE

Reports To:      Director of Service

Location:          United Kingdom

Position Summary:

The LTSA Service Manager is responsible for the full-service delivery lifecycle of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) across utility-scale BESS projects. This includes client management, contract execution, service provider oversight, performance reporting, site operations, spare parts management, and warranty claims.

This is a multifaceted service leadership role requiring strong technical and commercial acumen, hands-on operational coordination, and the ability to manage performance across multiple active sites. The position serves as a key point of contact for clients, operations and suppliers, ensuring that projects meet all contractual, safety, and performance standards.

Responsibilities:

•
Lead the negotiation of LTSA's with the client / owner and Sub-LTSA's with service providers.

•
Prepare and review detailed scopes of work for service providers and equipment suppliers.

•
Ensure that sites are operated in accordance with contractual requirements including achieving capacity and availability guarantees.

•
Manage service providers and equipment suppliers ensuring maintenance requirements are being completed to maintain equipment uptime in accordance with contractual obligations and manufacturers specifications.

•
Recommend opportunities to improve operational efficiencies.

•
Review and approve maintenance reports.

•
Determine spare part requirements and ensure spare part inventory is tracked and processed.

•
Analyze performance data determining root cause and performance trends.

•
Review monthly reports from service providers.

•
Assist with preparation of monthly reports to client / owner and present performance metrics and KPI's.

•
Build, develop, and grow any business relationships vital to the success of the project.

•
Conduct project postmortems and create recommendations report to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements.

•
Develop best practices and tools for project execution and management.

•
Ensure all environmental, health and safety policies and procedures are followed.

•
Complete other duties and projects as assigned.

•
Manage contractors and their performance.

•
Assisting with the capacity and balancing testing of batteries.

•
Manage liquidated damages and excludable events.

•
Serve as the primary client-facing representative, attending client meetings and managing queries.

•
Work alongside the operations service manager, field services supervisor and coordinator to ensure technicians are completing work to client expectation.

•
Create and manage monthly operations reports and other management reports.

•
Monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

•
Oversee the management of Preventative, Corrective, and Reactive maintenance.

Qualifications and Experience:

•
Engineering (Electrical or Mechanical) degree or diploma

•
Minimum 5 years' experience in project management in renewable power generation or service environment that includes electrical, controls, and network communication systems.

•
Strong negotiation, facilitation, risk management and consensus building skills.

•
Knowledge of general and national codes, medium voltage power systems and photovoltaic or Energy Storage system applications is an asset.

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally and influence positively a diverse group of executives, managers, and subject matter experts.

•
Proven ability to prioritize, manage multiple projects, and execute in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with a strong ownership mentality.

•
Professional-level capabilities with project management tools (e.g., MS 365 and Microsoft Project)

•
Must possess a valid UK driving licence with a clean driving record.

•
Must be able to travel to domestic locations as needed per project.

•
Ability to function successfully both independently and within a team.

•
Demonstrated professional appearance and conduct

Compensation & Benefits:

Canadian Solar offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a pension scheme, private medical insurance, life/disability cover, annual leave, and sick pay.

Canadian Solar Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Position Title: (Snr.) Commissioning Technician

Department: Commissioning

Entity: CS e-Storage

Reports To: Commissioning Manager

Location: UK – Remote

Position Summary:

The Commissioning Technician is an integral part of the commissioning team, with their main responsibility being to work with and support the commissioning engineer and their manager in the successful commissioning of our BESS projects. The successful candidate must be able and willing to travel and complete tasks at various project sites nation wide.

Responsibilities:

• Play a critical role on-site in the execution of BESS projects, from mechanical completion through to entering commercial operation,

• Perform task assigned by the commissioning manager and engineer, ranging from visual inspections through to electrical fault finding and beyond,

• Perform daily routine tasks such as executing commissioning test sheets, reviewing and logging issues/resolutions and helping to monitor the progress of the project’s commissioning activities,

• Support the commissioning of the overall control system by testing the network connectivity of all field devices and performing point-to-point tests,

• Provide on-site diagnostic, troubleshooting and hands-on support,

• Supervise subcontractors on-site where required,

• Assist in developing standard operating procedures from lessons learned on-site,

• Assist with the completion of testing documentation and preparation of test reports in a timely manner,

• Support client and their O&M contractor training,

• Adhere to all health and safety rules and policies,

• Attending and occasionally leading Plan of Day (POD) meetings,

• Willingness to travel domestically up to 100% of the time. Willingness to support internationally on occasion is advantageous,

• On occasion, be willing to work flexible hours (such as evenings and weekends).

Qualifications and Experience:

• Minimum NVQ/SVQ (or equivalent) level 3 in electrical discipline. HNC Preferred.

• Minimum 2 years’ relevant work experience in an installation, commissioning or service environment,

• Previous experience or training in the renewables sector highly desired,

• High Voltage and/or SCADA experience will be beneficial,

• Experience with HVAC/Liquid Chillers systems desirable,

• Comfortable working in a team and/or alone with good practical problem-solving skills,

• Strong written and verbal communication skills for engaging effectively with internal teams and contractors.

• Experience in Microsoft Office tools required, with experience in Smartsheets and Autodesk Construction Cloud advantageous.

• Candidate must possess a valid driving license and passport.

Compensation & Benefits:

Canadian Solar offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement.

Logistics & Warehouse Operations

RMA Process & Vendor Interface

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. Role Overview for Controls Engineer

As a Controls Engineer, you'll play a key role in deploying utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across America, supporting projects from initial design through commissioning and long-term operation.

You'll work closely with internal engineering teams, equipment vendors, EPCs, utilities, project developers, and customers to ensure control systems are designed, integrated, and delivered successfully. From reviewing control philosophies and validating network architectures to troubleshooting communications and supporting control related commissioning activities, you'll help ensure every project performs safely, reliably, and efficiently.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, collaborating across multiple disciplines, and seeing your work come to life in the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on the future of renewable energy while working on some of the industry's most advanced utility-scale energy storage projects.

What You'll Be Doing as a Controls Engineer

• Review project contracts and vendor agreements for controls-related requirements and ensure alignment throughout project execution.

• Review and validate project design packages, including electrical drawings, data flow diagrams, network designs, signal mappings (analog, Modbus, DNP3), electrical power models, and control narratives.

• Maintain and organize technical documentation within SharePoint while coordinating documentation flow with vendors and project stakeholders.

• Develop batch scripts and automation tools to streamline data collection and improve operational efficiency.

• Serve as a key technical resource for customers, EPCs, utilities, equipment vendors, and internal project teams throughout project execution.

• Troubleshoot network and communications issues within VPN-secured environments.

• Respond to customer and operator requests regarding system modifications, troubleshooting, and control system enhancements.

• Support site commissioning activities and provide technical expertise for all controls-related tasks.

• Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with engineering standards, project requirements, safety protocols, and company policies.

What You'll Bring to The Position

• Educational background in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience working with industrial control systems within electrical generation, renewable energy, or similar power system environments is required.

• Experience working with inverter-based resources (IBR) such as Battery Energy Storage Systems, solar, or other renewable generation technologies

• Exposure to substations, protective relays, and transformers is preferred.

• Demonstrated experience with industrial communication protocols including Modbus, DNP3, and TCP/IP.

• Strong understanding of industrial networking, including IP addressing, subnetting, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and network communications.

• Experience with SCADA systems, plant control systems, or utility-scale automation.

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.

• Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

• The right mix of education, experience, and technical expertise for the role.

• A passion for delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

• A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

Role Title: Senior Power Systems Technician

Team: Power Systems Team | UK LTSA Operations

Reports to: High Voltage Technical Manager (Regional)

Region: South / North / Central (UK)

Role type: Field-based, senior technical role

Purpose

Acts as the regional senior technical specialist for power systems and product commissioning across the UK BESS fleet. Leads product commissioning of e-STORAGE products (SolBank, string inverters, MVSkids etc) to OEM standard, leads HV/MV maintenance and safety activities across e-STORAGE and third-party fleets (i.e. SMA, Power Electronics) and develops the competency of the wider service team to support HV/MV works.

Scope Definition: Product Commissioning

This role leads product commissioning of e-STORAGE products: commissioning of e-STORAGE power conversion and MV equipment to OEM standard, including first power-on initialization parameters, product-level testing, and return-to-service. The site Commissioning (Cx) team retains overall site and project commissioning ownership, including the energisation programme, grid compliance and G99 testing, punch lists, and client handover. The Power Systems Technician works within the site Cx team's sequence: the Cx team owns the programme and the date; Power Systems owns the product Cx, safety documents, and product-level sign-off within it.

MV/HV Authorisation & Control of Work

Control of work and HV authorisation are determined by contract and project phase:

• During commissioning, the EPC (or Principal Contractor) is responsible for site control of work and HV authorisation. This role operates within the EPC's safe system of work and provides product-level expertise.

• During LTSA operations, the HV authorisation and control-of-work model is defined in each contract and varies by site (client-appointed, third-party, or CSE-held). This role provides the trained, competent personnel for appointment where CSE holds or is delegated that responsibility.

• Where a third party holds HV authorisation for a site, this role coordinates, supervises interfaces, and delivers the product-level technical work within their control regime.

Key Responsibilities

Product Commissioning (e-STORAGE products)

• Lead product commissioning of e-STORAGE products across UK LTSA sites (SolBank, string inverters, MVSkids and associated MV plant) to OEM standard and project scope.

• Own and set first power-on initialization parameters (OEM-trained personnel requirement per product manuals); incorrect settings risk equipment damage and certification non-compliance.

• Own product commissioning standards, procedures, test records, and documentation packs; ensure consistency across all UK projects.

• Provide product-level technical support to the site Cx team during energisation.

• Support the site Cx team during SAT and witness testing; provide product-level technical sign-off.

HV/MV Operations & Safety

• Competent for appointment to carry out MV/HV isolations, earthing, and safety document duties under the prevailing site safe system of work, as a mandatory precursor to intrusive PM/CM works. Site HV authorisation arrangements are defined per contract and phase (see MV/HV Authorisation & Control of Work).

• Carry out operational HV/MV switching during the service phase, including switching for planned PM outages, CM interventions, and restoration on return to service, where CSE holds control of work under the contract.

• Provide HV/MV support to the service team during PM and CM activities: isolations, earthing, switching, and safe access where service team work interfaces with HV/MV plant.

• Lead HV/MV preventative maintenance across CSE, SMA and Power Electronics MV skids, RMUs, transformers, and protection systems per OEM schedules.

• Lead corrective maintenance and fault investigation on HV/MV equipment: root cause analysis, rectification and return to service.

• Provide safety leadership and oversight for all HV/MV activities in region, including supervision of third-party HV contractors where used.

Technical Expertise & Capability Building

• Subject-matter expert across all inverter platforms (CSE string inverters, SMA, Power Electronics) for HV/MV maintenance activities; product commissioning expertise applies to e-STORAGE products.

• Assess and develop service team competency for HV/MV support roles; deliver toolbox talks, training, and authorisation recommendations.

• Feed field learnings back into standards, RAMS/SOPs, and OEM escalations.

Out of Scope

• Routine non-HV/MV maintenance (LV PM, BESS enclosure servicing, HVAC, general CM). This is delivered by the regional service team, with this role providing HV oversight only where work interfaces with HV/MV plant.

Requirements

• Trained and competent for MV/HV activities to 33kV; capable of appointment under company or client operational rules as contracts require.

• Time-served electrical background with utility-scale BESS or solar commissioning experience.

• Working knowledge of MV switchgear, transformers, and protection systems.

• Familiarity with G99 requirements sufficient to support the site Cx team during compliance testing.

• Full UK driving licence; regional and occasional national travel.

Facility Management

Preventive and Corrective Maintenance

·         Develop and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for Gas & Chemical systems and equipment.

·         Lead troubleshooting and recovery activities for major Gas & Chemical system failures.

·         Maintain adequate critical spare parts and coordinate repair or replacement of unreliable equipment.

Safety and Compliance

·         Ensure all Gas & Chemical operations comply with applicable local, state, and federal safety requirements, PVJC EHS requirements, and applicable industry standards.

·         Support compliance with applicable OSHA, NFPA, IFC, CGA, SEMI, and other requirements relevant to hazardous gases and chemicals.

·         Ensure gas detection, emergency shutdown, exhaust monitoring, alarms, and safety interlocks remain functional and are periodically tested.

·         Lead Gas & Chemical operational response to gas detection alarms, leaks, supply failures, exhaust abnormalities, and other emergency conditions.

·         Participate in risk assessments, MOC, incident investigations, emergency drills, and corrective action follow-up.

• Support sustainability and cost-reduction initiatives associated with Gas & Chemical operations.

• Review and approve Gas & Chemical SOPs, operating procedures, changeover procedures, emergency procedures, and maintenance instructions.

• Prepare and present reports on system availability, downtime, PM performance, inventory, gas/chemical consumption, incidents, projects, and outstanding actions.

• Ensure technical and operational documentation remains compliant with PVJC and regulatory requirements.

Vendor and Contractor Management

·         Ensure contractors comply with PVJC safety, QA/QC, engineering, and operational requirements.

·         Coordinate contractor activities, shutdown requirements, permits, system isolation, testing, and return-to-service activities.

·         Evaluate vendor and contractor performance and ensure service quality meets PVJC requirements.

·         Coordinate with suppliers to ensure reliable bulk gas, specialty gas, and chemical supply.

Team Collaboration

·         Assign work priorities and ensure sufficient manpower and shift coverage to support 24/7 manufacturing operations.

·         Provide technical and operational guidance to the Gas & Chemical team.

Qualifications

·         Supervisory or team leadership experience in a 24/7 manufacturing environment preferred.

·         Strong knowledge of bulk gas, specialty gas, and chemical supply and distribution systems.

·         Experience with hazardous gas systems, gas cabinets, BSGS, VMB/VMP, gas detection, exhaust monitoring, chemical distribution, and control systems is preferred.

·         Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.

·         Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, organizational, project management, and leadership skills.

·         Familiarity with applicable safety regulations, local requirements, and industry standards.

·         Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Skills

·         Experience with bulk cryogenic gas and specialty gas delivery systems.

·         Experience supervising contractors and industrial gas/chemical suppliers.

·         Ability to adapt to changing technologies and production requirements.

The Gas & Chemical Engineer is responsible for the engineering, reliability, operation support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of bulk gas, specialty gas, and chemical supply and distribution systems supporting PVJC manufacturing operations.

This position serves as a technical owner for assigned Gas & Chemical systems and works closely with Facility Operations, Production, Equipment Engineering, EHS, Quality, contractors, and gas/chemical suppliers to ensure systems operate safely, reliably, and within required process specifications.

·         Review and maintain appropriate alarm, warning, shutdown, and evacuation logic for hazardous gas systems.

Preventive & Corrective Maintenance

·         Develop and maintain preventive maintenance requirements for Gas & Chemical equipment.

·         Provide engineering support for troubleshooting equipment failures, abnormal pressure/flow, gas detection alarms, exhaust issues, supply interruptions, leakage, valve failures, instrumentation faults, and control system abnormalities.

·         Perform root cause analysis for recurring failures and production-impacting incidents.

·         Develop and track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

·         Analyze equipment performance and maintenance history to improve system reliability.

·         Support calibration, functional testing, leak testing, pressure testing, and verification of critical instrumentation and safety devices.

Controls, Monitoring & FMCS

·         Define and maintain required operating parameters, alarms, trends, and monitoring points within FMCS/TGMS.

·         Review alarm history and system trends to identify developing equipment or process issues.

·         Establish appropriate warning and critical alarm thresholds.

·         Support control logic development for automatic shutdown, isolation, changeover, backup supply, and emergency response.

·         Ensure critical Gas & Chemical operating data is available to Facility Operations for effective system monitoring.

Project Engineering & Commissioning

·         Review Gas & Chemical designs for new installations, production expansion, Phase 2 projects, and system modifications.

·         Review contractor and supplier technical submittals for compliance with PVJC requirements.

·         Participate in design reviews, FAT/SAT where applicable, construction inspections, system walkdowns, punch-list development, commissioning, startup, and final acceptance.

·         Verify systems are properly tested and documented before turnover to Facility Operations.

·         Ensure lessons learned from existing systems are incorporated into future installations.

QA/QC & System Acceptance

·         Verify final installations comply with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable standards.

·         Maintain technical records for system testing, commissioning, maintenance, calibration, and modifications.

Job Description:

A Quality Technician ensures the quality and reliability of solar cells, raw materials, and components across specialized quality control (QC) areas. Reporting to the QC Supervisor or Quality Engineer, this role executes inspections, conducts tests, documents results, and supports issue resolution within a designated focus area (e.g., Incoming Quality Control, Outgoing Quality Control, Reliability Testing, Metrology, or In-Process Quality Control). Technicians adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs), regulatory standards (e.g., ISO), and customer specifications to maintain consistent product quality.

Core Responsibilities:

• Adhere to SOPs, safety protocols, regulatory requirements (ISO 9001), and the company’s quality/environmental policies.

• Document test results, inspection data, and non-conformities accurately in quality management systems

• Report defects, discrepancies, or equipment issues to the QC Supervisor promptly.

• Maintain cleanliness and calibration of tools/equipment used in the assigned area.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (other department) to address quality concerns.

• Participate in training programs to stay updated on processes, standards, and new technologies.

• Perform other quality-related duties assigned by the Quality Manager and/or Supervisor to support organizational quality objectives.

Specialized Responsibilities by Area

1. Incoming Quality Control (IQC) Technician

• Inspect incoming raw materials (e.g., silicon wafers, chemicals) to ensure they meet purchase orders and quality standards.

• Test materials (e.g., thickness, purity) using tools.

• Reject non-conforming materials and work with suppliers/procurement to resolve issues.

• Track records of incoming quality, including pass/fail rates and supplier performance.

2. Outgoing Quality Control (OQC) Technician

• Perform final checks on finished product batches to confirm they meet customer and internal standards.

• Test sample cells (e.g., efficiency, EL/PL imaging) from each production lot.

• Verify product packaging, labels, and shipping documents.

• Approve/reject batches based on results; escalate problematic lots to the QC Supervisor.

• Create quality reports for customers or internal teams.

3. Reliability Testing Technician

• Run tests on solar cells to check long-term performance and durability.

• Monitor test conditions, record data (e.g., efficiency loss), and document failures.

• Help analyze results to spot reliability trends or design flaws.

• Maintain test equipment (e.g., chambers) and ensure accurate environmental controls (temperature, humidity).

4. Metrology Technician

• Calibrate and maintain precision tools (e.g., EL/PL imagers, IV curve tracers).

• Conduct routine checks to ensure equipment accuracy and compliance with ISO 17025.

• Troubleshoot malfunctions and coordinate repairs with maintenance or vendors.

• Document calibration records and train others on proper tool use.

5. In-Process Quality Control (IPQC) Technician

• Monitor solar cell production at key stages.

• Conduct inline inspections using measuring instruments.

• Collect real-time process data and compare it to specifications.

• Alert production teams to deviations and help adjust processes to prevent defects.

• Track yield rates and identify defect trends at specific manufacturing step.

Qualifications & Skills

• Associate’s degree in Electrical Technology, Materials Science, or a related field (preferred).

• Minimum 3 years in quality control within manufacturing, with preference for solar cell fabrication, semiconductor, or renewable energy industries.

• Familiarity with the specific focus area (e.g., incoming inspections) is preferred.

• Quality management certifications (e.g., ASQ Certified Quality Technician) or specialized training (e.g., metrology, reliability testing) are a plus.

• Skilled with tools/equipment specific to the assigned area (e.g., imagers for OQC).

• Basic understanding of statistical process control (SPC) and quality metrics (e.g., CPK, yield).

• Ability to interpret technical drawings, spec sheets, and industry standards (ISO 9001).

• Proficient in office software (e.g., MS Excel for data analysis, Word for documentation).

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.

• Effective verbal/written communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate cross-functionally.

• Basic problem-solving abilities to identify defects or process deviations.

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, manage priorities, and follow instructions.

Working Conditions:

• Primarily works in a manufacturing facility, including cleanrooms, labs or controlled-environment production areas.

• Potential exposure to low-level chemicals or equipment noise; appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is provided and required.

• This role works 12-hour shifts, which may include day, evening, or night shifts, depending on production needs. Occasional overtime may be needed to support production deadlines, urgent quality issue resolution, audit preparations or urgent tasks.

• May involve standing for extended periods, moving between workstations, and lifting.

This is a delivery-facing coordination role for someone who combines exceptional administration with the confidence to operate across clients, contractors, engineering teams and construction sites. About e-STORAGE

e-STORAGE, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar, designs, manufactures and integrates battery energy storage systems for utility-scale applications. The UK Project Implementation team delivers complex BESS projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. Our work depends on disciplined project controls, clear interfaces and accurate, timely information.

Role purpose

The Project Coordinator is an embedded member of the project delivery team, not a purely administrative support function. The role supports multiple projects and acts as a close working partner to the Project Manager, coordinating information, maintaining control of deliverables and driving actions through to closure. The successful candidate will be trusted with demanding, detail heavy work and will progressively take ownership of defined project management activities as capability develops.

What you will Own

Project controls, programme and reporting

• Maintain project trackers, action logs, decision logs, risk registers, deliverable schedules and other project control tools, ensuring information is current, complete and auditable.

• Track progress against the approved programme and key milestones, obtain updates from responsible owners, identify slippage or missing

• Support weekly and monthly reporting by gathering factual progress data, checking consistency and preparing clear updates for internal leadership and client review.

• Coordinate meeting agendas, papers, minutes and actions; confidently speak to status, challenge overdue owners and present updates in open project forums.

Document control, transmittals and information flow

• Own or support the Master Document Register and project deliverable trackers, including document status, revisions, review periods, approvals and resubmissions.

• Prepare, quality check and issue client, contractor and supplier transmittals in accordance with project requirements; maintain clear records of what was sent, when, to whom and at which revision.

• Check project documents for completeness, naming, formatting, revision control and required approvals before issue.

• Maintain organised project workspaces in SharePoint, Smartsheet and other approved systems, promoting consistent folder structures, templates and version control.

• Coordinate the flow of information between the client, BOP/EPC contractors, subcontractors, suppliers and internal engineering, quality, commissioning, commercial and HSE teams.

Construction coordination and site support

• Attend UK project sites regularly and build effective working relationships with site teams, contractors and client representatives.

• Support the Project Manager and Construction Manager with progress verification, delivery tracking, inspections, punch-list items, site records and closure of minor construction actions.

• Review straightforward construction information, drawings, photographs and records within competence, raising discrepancies or incomplete evidence to the appropriate technical owner rather than making unauthorised technical decisions.

• Participate in site and coordination meetings, maintaining a visible, confident and professional presence in construction environments.

• Follow project HSE arrangements, site rules and safe systems of work at all times.

Commercial and contractual administration

• Maintain registers for notices, variations, instructions, RFIs, early warnings, payment milestones and other contractual correspondence as directed by the Project Manager.

• Track contractual and client submission dates and review periods, highlighting impending deadlines and overdue responses.

• Apply sound foundation-level understanding of scope, obligations, records and change control when handling project information, escalating contractual interpretation to the Project Manager or Commercial team.

• Support procurement and subcontract administration through requisitions, vendor documentation, commitments, delivery status and approval workflows.

Continuous improvement

• Identify repetitive, unclear or inefficient ways of working and propose practical improvements to templates, trackers, workflows and reporting.

• Help establish standard, scalable project controls across the UK portfolio while respecting project-specific contractual requirements.

• Use Microsoft 365 tools and approved digital solutions intelligently to reduce manual handling, strengthen traceability and improve the quality of project information.

• Take personal ownership of follow-through: clarify the next action, agree the owner and date, and keep momentum until closure.

What good looks like

• Project information can be trusted: registers, trackers, transmittals and records are accurate, current and easy to audit.

• Programme commitments are actively followed up; overdue actions and emerging slippage are visible early rather than discovered late.

• Project Managers have more time for leadership, commercial decisions and stakeholder management because coordination and administration are under control.

• Clients and contractors receive clear, professional and timely communication.

• Processes improve over time, with lessons captured and converted into practical working standards.

About You

Essential:

• Highly organised, resilient and comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines and detail-heavy administrative tasks.

• Demonstrable experience in project coordination, project administration, document control, construction support or a comparable delivery environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including confidence to speak in meetings, ask direct questions and follow up senior stakeholders.

• Advanced practical capability in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams; able to build and maintain reliable trackers and reports.

• Ability to read and understand a project programme, monitor activities and milestones, and translate updates into clear actions.

• High attention to detail, strong ownership and a habit of checking accuracy before information is issued.

• Comfortable travelling to and working on active UK construction sites, with a full UK driving licence or reliable means of reaching project locations.

• Right to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable:

• Ability to interpret basic civil, mechanical or electrical drawings and recognise when an issue requires technical escalation.

• Relevant qualification in project management, engineering, construction, business administration or equivalent practical experience.

• Current CSCS card and/or IOSH, SSSTS or SMSTS training.

The person we are looking for

You may already be a strong Project Coordinator, Project Administrator, Document Controller or Assistant Project Manager who wants broader delivery exposure. You will be naturally rigorous, willing to challenge constructively and motivated by making projects run better. You do not need to be the technical expert in every discussion, but you must be curious, credible and confident enough to identify gaps, obtain answers and keep actions moving.

Development and progression

The role offers close exposure to Project Managers, Project Directors and cross-functional specialists across engineering, construction, commissioning, quality, HSE and commercial. For the right individual, it provides a strong foundation for progression toward Assistant Project Manager and Project Manager responsibilities, based on demonstrated capability and business need.

Working arrangements

• Regular domestic travel is a core part of the role and may increase during delivery, construction and commissioning periods.

• Working outside normal hours may be required to support critical project activities, site access or major milestones.

• Build practical experience across the full project lifecycle, from mobilisation and design through construction, commissioning and handover.

This position supports the Mechanical Supervisor in maintaining safe, reliable, efficient, and continuous operation of critical mechanical utilities. The Engineer is responsible for system monitoring, troubleshooting, preventive and corrective maintenance support, reliability improvement, engineering analysis, system modifications, project execution, commissioning, and technical documentation.

Facility Management

·         Coordinate technical matters with contractors, equipment vendors, OEMs, Project teams, Production, EHS, and other stakeholders.

• Troubleshoot mechanical equipment and utility system abnormalities and recommend corrective actions.

• Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for significant equipment failures, utility interruptions, recurring alarms, and production-impacting events.

• Identify critical spare parts and consumables required to maintain system reliability.

• Develop technical specifications and recommendations for replacement or upgrade of unreliable, inefficient, or obsolete equipment.

• Ensure technical modifications do not compromise equipment safeguards, design pressure, operating limits, accessibility, or maintainability.

• Participate in risk assessments, Management of Change (MOC), incident investigations, emergency response, and corrective action activities.

• Provide technical support during major utility leaks, mechanical equipment failures, loss of cooling/heating/ventilation, and other emergency conditions.

• Identify and immediately escalate unsafe equipment conditions, temporary repairs, abnormal operating conditions, or potentially production-impacting risks.

• Support energy-saving projects and verify performance improvements following implementation.

• Support Facility sustainability, energy conservation, and utility cost-reduction initiatives.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation for system modifications and support Management of Change (MOC) requirements.

• Ensure engineering drawings and operational documentation are updated following equipment or system modifications.

• Support evaluation of vendor and equipment performance and recommend improvements where required.

Position Title: QC Shift Supervisor I

Department: Quality

Reports To: Quality Manager

Location: Jeffersonville, Indiana

The Quality Control Shift Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily quality assurance and control activities throughout the solar cell manufacturing process. This role ensures that solar cells meet strict industry standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements. The supervisor leads a team of quality control technicians and inspectors, implements testing protocols, identifies defects, and collaborates with production, engineering, and facilities teams to resolve quality issues. The ultimate goal is to minimize production waste, improve product reliability, and maintain the company’s reputation for high-performance solar cells.

Primary Responsibilities:

· Manage daily workflows of the quality control team, including supervision, training, inspection scheduling, and task prioritization.

· Oversee in-process quality control and final outgoing quality inspections of solar cells at critical manufacturing stages.

· Ensure products meet customer requirements and comply with testing protocols, performance parameters (e.g., efficiency, Voc), and quality acceptance criteria.

· Investigate recurring defects using available measuring instruments (e.g., EL/PL imagers, IV curve tracers, microscopy).

· Collaborate with production and engineering teams to implement corrective actions and track their effectiveness.

· Conduct internal audits to ensure compliance with SOPs, regulatory standards, and customer requirements.

· Prepare documentation for external audits and address non-conformities.

· Drive initiatives to improve product quality and reduce scrap rates.

· Develop, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Training Manuals for quality control activities enhancement (e.g., inspection protocols, testing methods, defect reporting) and ensure alignment with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality objectives.

· Establish and maintain quality weekly/daily reports and quality data systems.

· Understand and adhere to the company’s quality and environmental policies, as well as relevant environmental factors and management programs.

· Perform other duties assigned by the Quality Manager to support the organization’s overall quality objectives.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Materials Science), Quality Management, or a related field, preferred.

· Minimum 3 years of experience in quality department within a manufacturing environment. Solar cell fabrication, semiconductor manufacturing, or renewable energy industries preferred.

· 1+ years of prior supervisory experience and proven people leadership managing teams of 3+ employees.

· Understanding of ISO 9001:2015 standards and experience in ISO audits (internal and external); ability to conduct internal audits.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret quality data and drive data-based decisions.

· Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), root cause analysis (RCA) tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams), and data analysis software (Excel, Minitab).

· Strong sense of accountability, problem-solving acumen, and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments.

· Proficiency in quality documentation (e.g., SOPs, audit reports) and report writing; experience developing training materials for technical or quality processes.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

· Skilled in common office software (e.g., MS Excel for data analysis, Word for documentation).

Working Conditions:

· Primarily works in a manufacturing facility, including cleanroom or controlled-environment production areas.

· Exposure to low levels of chemicals or equipment noise may occur; personal protective equipment (PPE) is provided

· May require occasional overtime to support production deadlines, urgent quality issue resolution, audit preparations or urgent tasks.

Compensation and Benefits:

CS Powertech offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a 401(k) Retirement Plan, medical/dental/life/disability program, PTO and sick days. This is a full-time position.

CS Powertech is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Department: U.S. Manufacturing & Operations
Location: Dallas TX
Reports To: Sr. Director, Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

The Master Planning Manager is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing integrated master planning strategies across U.S. manufacturing operations.

This role serves as a critical link between Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Logistics to ensure demand and supply alignment, optimize production capacity, improve inventory efficiency, and support on-time customer deliveries.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in manufacturing planning, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), capacity management, and cross-functional coordination within a complex manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Master Production Planning

• Develop and maintain an integrated Master Production Schedule (MPS) based on customer demand, sales forecasts, production capacity, and material availability.

• Coordinate production planning activities across multiple manufacturing facilities to ensure alignment with business priorities.

• Translate sales forecasts and customer orders into executable production plans.

• Monitor production performance against established plans and proactively address scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, and material shortages.

• Establish short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons to support operational and business objectives.

2. Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)

• Lead and coordinate the S&OP process to align demand forecasts, supply capabilities, inventory targets, and business priorities.

• Partner with Sales and Commercial teams to understand customer demand, order pipelines, and forecast changes.

• Work closely with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to evaluate production capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.

• Identify supply-demand gaps and recommend solutions to support business continuity.

• Facilitate regular cross-functional planning meetings and provide management with actionable recommendations.

3. Capacity & Resource Planning

• Evaluate manufacturing capacity, equipment utilization, labor availability, and production constraints.

• Develop capacity planning models to support production optimization and future business growth.

• Collaborate with manufacturing leadership to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

• Support resource allocation and production prioritization across manufacturing operations.

4. Inventory & Supply Chain Optimization

• Partner with Procurement, Material Planning, and Logistics teams to ensure material availability and inventory alignment with production requirements.

• Monitor inventory levels, material lead times, and supply risks to minimize production disruptions.

• Support inventory optimization initiatives to reduce excess inventory, improve inventory turnover, and minimize working capital requirements.

• Identify opportunities to improve planning efficiency and supply chain responsiveness.

5. Planning Systems & Process Improvement

• Develop and standardize master planning processes, reporting mechanisms, and planning tools across U.S. operations.

• Utilize ERP systems and planning tools to improve demand visibility, production scheduling, and inventory management.

• Establish planning dashboards and performance reporting to support management decision-making.

• Identify opportunities for process automation, data accuracy improvement, and operational efficiency.

• Support the integration and alignment of planning processes across different manufacturing facilities and business units.

6.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

• Serve as the central coordination point for integrated planning activities across Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Logistics.

• Facilitate effective communication between commercial and operational teams regarding production capabilities and delivery commitments.

• Lead planning-related continuous improvement initiatives.

• Support organizational integration and process standardization across U.S. manufacturing operations.

• Provide regular planning updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to senior management.

Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Experience

• Minimum 10 years of experience in production planning, supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, or related functions.

• At least 3 years of experience in a planning leadership or management role preferred.

• Proven experience in Master Production Scheduling, S&OP, demand planning, and capacity planning.

• Experience working in a multi-site manufacturing environment strongly preferred.

• Experience in solar, battery, electronics, automotive, or other complex manufacturing industries is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong understanding of manufacturing planning processes, production capacity management, and supply chain operations.

• Proficiency in ERP and advanced planning systems, such as SAP, Oracle, or equivalent platforms.

• Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other data analytics tools preferred.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Strong organizational and project management capabilities.

• Ability to translate complex operational data into actionable business recommendations.

Position Title:   Warehouse Shift Supervisor

Department:  Supply Chain

Entity: PVJC

Reports To: Warehouse Manager, US Mfg. Op

Location:  Jeffersonville, IN

Position Summary:

The Warehouse Shift Supervisor will play a pivotal role in supporting the Warehouse Supervisor and Manager in supporting daily warehouse operations, ensuring the inbound/outbound, handling, posting and distribution of goods. This supervisory-level position demands a solid foundation in warehouse operations, staff coordination, and adherence to regulatory standards. The Warehouse Specialist will work closely with the Warehouse Supervisor and ultimately align with the direction of the Warehouse Manager to uphold operational excellence and maintain a safe, orderly environment within the warehouse.

Primary Responsibilities:

•
Assist in carrying out all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, inventory management, and the distribution of goods;

•
Support the implementation and maintenance of effective inventory control systems and participate in regular audits to verify accuracy and mitigate losses;

•
Assist the Warehouse Supervisor, under the overall direction of the Hiring Manager, in coordinating with the Accounting Team to ensure accurate inventory tracking, timely reporting, and adherence to budgetary guidelines

•
Ensure all warehouse activities comply with health and safety regulations, promote a culture of safety, and participate in routine safety training;

•
Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and productivity within warehouse operations;

•
Assist with tactical efforts to help facilitate management efforts related to planning and managing warehouse space utilization to maximize storage capacity and optimize workflow;

•
Carry out and functions using the warehouse management systems (WMS) and other technological tools to streamline operations effectively;

•
Assist the Warehouse Supervisor to help track expenditures in supporting budget management, including cost control and preparation of financial reports;

Qualifications and Experience:

•
A minimum of at least 3 years’ experience in warehouse operations, ideally in a high-volume manufacturing facility.  (A senior specialist should bring 4 to 5 years in such roles). Also warehouse operations experience should include strong skills and background with SAP and Microsoft office

•
Associate or Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or other training in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field though open to those without advanced education but with solid experience.

•
Proven expertise in warehouse support functions, ideally within manufacturing sectors;

•
Some working knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS) and other relevant software;

•
Working familiarity with local, state, and federal regulations related to warehouse operations;

•
Strong communication skills

•
Forklift certification is preferred

Compensation and Benefits:

CS Powertech offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a 401(k) Retirement Plan, medical/life/disability program, and PTO.

Entity:                   U.S. Cell Manufacturing (USCM)

Reports To:         Senior Supervisor, Planning and Material Control

Location:             Jeffersonville, Indiana

• Work closely with the Warehouse to ensure Production Orders are fulfilled

• Issues purchase orders to the Purchasing team

•
